question: The Pradhan Mantri Yuva Udyamita Vikas Abhiyan Yojana (PM-YUVA) is the initiative of Ministry of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**__**.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Yuva Udyamita Vikas Abhiyan Yojana (PM-YUVA) **is the **initiative** of the **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.**
 
• **Main highlights of this scheme**__:
 
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri YUVA (Yuva Udyamita Vikas Abhiyan) Yojana [PM-YUVA Yojana]** is a centrally sponsored scheme launched in **2016 **to implement entrepreneurship education training for upcoming entrepreneurs and students.
 
• The PM-YUVA Yojana is the flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. It aims to establish an enabling ecosystem for entrepreneurship development through **entrepreneurship training, education, **and **advocacy. **
 
• The PM-YUVA Yojana also promotes social enterprises for inclusive growth and facilitates easy access to an entrepreneurship support network. It provides easy access to an entrepreneurship support network of over** 14 lakh** youth to initiate maximum start-ups over five years (2016-17 to 2020-21).
